parameters.value:
[{"name": "firmware-strict-native-causal", "command": "bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
export VERDIFY_DEVICE_WRITE_ENABLED=0 KUBECONFIG=/dev/null
unset PGHOST PGPORT PGDATABASE PGUSER PGPASSWORD DATABASE_URL GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "bdef62c1d640636411995c23aedeee85f342303f"
uv sync --python 3.12 --extra dev --extra api --extra planner --extra planner-graph
export PYTHON="$PWD/.venv/bin/python"
export QUALIFICATION_DIR=/tmp/verdify-native-causal-bdef62c1-01
set +e
make test-firmware firmware-invariants
native_rc=$?
timeout 600s bash docs/handoffs/firmware-validity-dwell-20261018/causal-regressions.sh
causal_rc=$?
THRESHOLD_PCT=0 BUILD_DIR=/tmp/verdify-native-worktree-bdef62c1-01 DIFF_OUT=/tmp/verdify-native-worktree-bdef62c1-01.diff make firmware-replay-worktree OLD=2999abe5f4348ff17b8fd11931247f2c3c5fd107
worktree_rc=$?
set -e
python3 - "$QUALIFICATION_DIR" <<"CUSTODY"
import base64,hashlib,json,os,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); total=0; count=0
if root.is_dir():
 for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
  st=p.lstat()
  if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_nlink!=1:continue
  if p.suffix not in {".log",".xml",".json",".txt",".cpp"}:continue
  if st.st_size>4*1024*1024:raise RuntimeError("native custody file exceeds4MiB")
  total+=st.st_size
  if total>16*1024*1024:raise RuntimeError("native custody exceeds16MiB")
  data=p.read_bytes();count+=1
  print("NATIVE_CUSTODY_FILE="+json.dumps({"path":str(p.relative_to(root)),"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"data_b64":base64.b64encode(data).decode()},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
print("NATIVE_CUSTODY_SUMMARY="+json.dumps({"files":count,"bytes":total}),flush=True)
CUSTODY
printf "FIRMWARE_STRICT_RESULTS={\"native\":%d,\"causal\":%d,\"worktree_replay\":%d}\n" "$native_rc" "$causal_rc" "$worktree_rc"
[ "$native_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$causal_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$worktree_rc" -eq 0 ]
' "}]
